defaults.timeframe: Daily historical feed in tutorial; no class-enforced timeframe

sources.entry: When flat and no tracked pending order: close[0]<close[-1] AND close[-1]<close[-2]; submit market buy. This is two strict declines across three closes, not three declines.
sources.exit: When holding and no tracked pending order: len(self)>=bar_executed+5; submit market sell using default sizer. notify_order sets bar_executed=len(self) on every completed buy or sell and clears tracked order on terminal status.
sources.order_lifecycle: Submitted/Accepted notifications leave pending reference active. Completed,Canceled,Margin,Rejected clear it. No pyramiding while pending/holding. No automatic replacement or invented timeout.
sources.native_timing_proof: Synthetic source execution BUY at open index1 and SELL at open index7. Entry completion observed on barE,exit submitted at close E+5 and filled open E+6; do not describe this as an open-to-open five-bar hold.
sources.startup_blocker: No explicit minperiod or len>=3 guard; bare close line permits first next() at bar0. Negative history can wrap into preloaded future rows.
sources.future_mutation_proof: Changing only final synthetic bar changed first-bar pending buy from true to false and shifted fills from1/7 to3/9.

defaults.native_timeframe: Source harness feed,not class-enforced;8h is an adaptation

sources.setup: Buy flip requires current close<close[-4] AND previous close>close[-5]; sell flip uses inverse strict comparisons. Flip activates direction and resets both counters. While active, qualifying closes increment that setup count. At9, if not already that setup, reset_setup and activate countdown; opposite setup/countdown canceled by default.
sources.setup_range: At9 the recorded extreme range uses offsets-8 through-1,excluding the current9th bar. Preserve actual loop rather than textbook nine-bar range.
sources.cancel: Default cancel_1 resets both setups/countdowns when current low exceeds recorded buy-high or current high falls below recorded sell-low. cancel_3/recycle conditional branch has pass only; cancel_1618 is declared but not implemented. Do not invent those textbook behaviors.
sources.countdown: Default comparison uses close. Buy count increments when close<=low[-2],sell when close>=high[-2],capped13. At count8 save current comparison value; this assignment repeats on later bars while count remains8. At count13 buy requires current low<=saved buyVal,sell requires current high>=saved sellVal. Preserve these actual state updates.
sources.entry_exit: Ideal buy signal buys10units only when flat. Ideal sell signal closes any position; no short entry. Each accepted13condition clears corresponding setup/countdown even if position prevents an order.
sources.pending_order_blocker: buy/close results are not assigned to self.order; next() has no pending-order guard. notify_order increments fill counters and clears self.order,but does not establish a pending lock. Delayed/rejected order/reentry semantics need proof,not an invented guard.
sources.startup_blocker: len(close)>4 permits len5 but then accesses close[-5]. Pinned cloudQuant linebuffer indexes array[idx+ago]; preloaded negative index can select final future bar.
sources.future_mutation_proof: In standard pinned Backtrader, final-bar-only mutation changes bar4 buyTrigfalse/tdsl0 to buyTrigtrue/tdsl1. No filled trade was needed to demonstrate persistent state contamination.

sources.label: UpDownCandlesStrategy_actual40barContrarianReturn
sources.license: Publisher repository GPL-3.0; source/framework stays outside Git
sources.reference_limit: Credited original repository lookup returned404; original-author and source parity unestablished. Pinned cloudQuant implementation remains the inspected public source.
sources.feature: r=(close[0]-close[-40])/close[-40]; denominator0 yields0. Candle-strength20 counts bullish/bearish bodies,ignores doji and returns0.5ifall doji,but is never used by entry/exit.
sources.entry: With no pending order,first return early whenever abs(r)<0.01. If flat,buy10units at r<-0.01 or short10units at r>0.01. Equality causes no flat entry.
sources.actual_exit: The same early-return guard applies while holding. A long closes only when r>=+0.01; a short closes only when r<=-0.01. This is not an exit near zero or within the threshold despite comments. Market close,next-open execution.
sources.order_lifecycle: Submitted/Accepted retain tracked order; terminal completion/cancel/margin/rejection clears it. Flat/position branch prevents same-call close/reentry. No protective callback orders.
sources.startup_blocker: PercentReturnsPeriod requests minperiod40 but accesses40bars back,requiring41observations. First computed output can read preloaded final row.
sources.future_mutation_proof: Final-bar-only mutation changes bar39 return from-0.76to23.0; next-open order side changes BUY10toSELL10.
